description: The pie chart titled "Distribution of data source in the AttrEval-Simulation" represents the proportion of data sources used in a simulation. There are five slices in the chart, each corresponding to a different data source. The largest slice, representing 26.0% of the data, is colored blue and is labeled "ENTITYQUEST." The second largest slice, colored red and representing 24.2% of the data, is labeled "HOTPOTQA." The third slice, colored orange and representing 22.7% of the data, is labeled "TRIVIAQA." The fourth slice, colored yellow and representing 21.6% of the data, is labeled "POPQA." The smallest slice, colored green and representing 1.9% of the data, is labeled "TREC." The chart includes percentage labels inside the slices and a legend is not present. The slices are not visually emphasized in any particular way.
